status.en: 31 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 48% more than the week before, most of them in Manila, Philippine and Davao.
status.nb: 31 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 48 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Manila, Philippine og Davao.

summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 29 passengers and crew from a distressed boat in Palawan and then suspended small-vessel travel there because of rough seas, while a landing craft tank sank off Surigao del Sur spilling about 800 liters of oil onto 200 metres of shoreline. A Chinese survey ship entered Scarborough Shoal, prompting Manila to summon the Chinese ambassador, and the Chinese coast guard continued patrols around Diaoyu Dao. Former NPA rebels were redeployed as forest guards to protect the environment in Borongan, and 10ID and partners boosted intelligence cooperation through a workshop. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinernes kystvakt reddet 29 passasjerer og mannskap fra en nødstilt båt i Palawan og suspendert deretter småfartøysreiser på grunn av røft sjøforhold, mens et landingsfartøy sank utenfor Surigao del Sur og slapp omtrent 800 liter olje på 200 meter kystlinje. Et kinesisk undersøkelsesskip gikk inn i Scarborough-revet, noe som fikk Manila til å innkalle den kinesiske ambassadøren, og den kinesiske kystvakten fortsatte patruljer rundt Diaoyu Dao. Tidligere NPA-opprørere ble omplassert som skogvoktere for å beskytte miljøet i Borongan, og 10ID og samarbeidspartnere styrket etterretningssamarbeidet gjennom en workshop. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
